progress.intro: This is a gentle activity log for family and caregivers — not a test score. Consistency and enjoyment matter more than "getting it right."
progress.noSessions: No sessions logged yet — try an exercise from the home screen.

settings.stageDesc: Adjusts item counts, choices, and pacing across every exercise — fewer distractors and more time for middle stage.
settings.languageDesc: Changes the language used across the whole app.
settings.facesDesc: Personalize with real family & friends so the "Faces I Know" exercise practices names that matter.
settings.themesDesc: Choose which reminiscence topics appear in Memory Lane.

checkin.disclaimerTitle: This is not a medical diagnosis
checkin.disclaimerBody: These informal activities are inspired by tasks doctors use (like the clock-drawing test), but they are not validated clinical tests and cannot diagnose dementia or determine its stage. Please share the summary with a doctor, who can decide on formal testing and next steps.

wordShow.title: Remember these words
wordShow.instructions: Take a moment to remember these words. You'll be asked about them again after a couple of short tasks.

clock.numbersInstructions: Tap where each number belongs on the clock face, starting with 12.
clock.handsInstructions: Now drag the hands to show {{time}}.
clock.skipNumbers: Skip the rest of the numbers

wordRecall.title: What were those words?
wordRecall.instructions: Type the words that come to mind — it's fine if not all of them do.

caregiver.title: A few questions for the caregiver
caregiver.instructions: Answer based on changes you've noticed over the last several months.
caregiver.q1: Managing money or bills seems harder than it used to be
caregiver.q2: Repeats questions or stories more than before
caregiver.q3: Gets confused about time or place more than before
caregiver.q4: Needs more help with dressing, bathing, or personal care
caregiver.q5: Has stopped or reduced hobbies they used to enjoy
caregiver.q6: Misplaces items or puts them in unusual places more often

summary.title: Check-in summary
summary.shareNote: Share this summary with a doctor — it's a helpful starting point, not a diagnosis.
summary.clockDetail: Placed {{placed}} of 12 numbers in roughly the right spot; hands were {{hands}}.
summary.handsInaccurate: not quite matching the requested time
summary.wordRecallDetail: Recalled {{recalled}} of {{total}} words after a short delay.
summary.caregiverDetail: {{count}} of {{total}} items flagged as noticeably changed.

q1.prompt: Before smartphones, what did people often use to take photographs?

q2.prompt: What did many families gather around to listen to music or the news long ago?

q3.prompt: Before streaming, how did people usually listen to their favorite music at home?

q4.prompt: How did most people send a message to someone far away, long ago?

q5.prompt: Before mobile phones, how did people make a call away from home?

q6.prompt: What did people often use to keep food cool before electric refrigerators were common?

q7.prompt: How did people usually watch their favorite shows long ago?

q8.prompt: What did people often ride to get around town before cars were common?
